title: Dashcam & Bodycam Video – Pursuit Initiation, Sept. 19, 2024 (Anthony B. Smith)

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Kentucky Open Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

Records concerning the September 19, 2024 vehicle pursuit of Anthony B. Smith, which began with Benton Police officers and ended in a fatal wrong-way crash on Interstate 430 in Little Rock. Specifically:

1. All in-car (dashcam) and body-worn camera video from every Benton officer involved, from the start of the pursuit to its end.
2. Radio/dispatch audio and CAD logs for the pursuit.
3. The pursuit report and any pursuit review.

Please provide video and audio in their original digital format, with audio intact, via download link or file-sharing service. If any portion is withheld or redacted, please cite the specific exemption for each item.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 5 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Luka Thriller

title: Settlement in Ackerman v. Gaston County Schools

communications.subject: North Carolina Public Records Law Request: Settlement in Ackerman v. Gaston County Schools
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the North Carolina Public Records Law, I hereby request the following records:

1. Any settlement agreement in Ackerman v. Gaston County Schools, filed as No. 3:26-cv-564 in the United States District Court for the Western District of North Carolina.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 business days.

Sincerely,

Adam Steinbaugh
